inside-fridges.title: Inside the fridges: cool section
inside-fridges.description: Remove the drawers. Clean inside the door and the bottom.

oven-area.title: Around the oven
oven-area.description: Organize the area, bring out the gastronorm containers, clean the knife gastronorm container, and clean the top of the oven.

storage.title: Dry storage
storage.description: Remove everything from the top and bottom shelves. Send spices, boxes, and kitchen tools we do not use to Montergarden.

under-sink.title: Under the sink
under-sink.description: Make sure it is dry and well stocked.

inside-extraction-bell.title: Inside the extraction hood
inside-extraction-bell.description: Remove the covers, go up, and clean all surfaces inside with degreaser, water, and soap.

behind-fridges.title: Behind the freezer
behind-fridges.description: Pull out the freezer. Sweep, clean wax from the black boards, and wash them.

inside-oven.title: Inside the oven
inside-oven.description: Clean the metal rails. Clean the inside by hand with water and soap. In the door area, remove crumbs from the gap and clean the rubber seal.

induction-stoves.title: Induction units
induction-stoves.description: Clean the filters and the fan area, including the back and bottom.

outside-extraction-hood.title: Outside the extraction hood
outside-extraction-hood.description: Clean all surfaces without removing the covers, including the light area and the outside and top where possible.

dishwasher.title: Dishwasher
dishwasher.description: Remove the water. Scrub the walls that are not usually scrubbed. Clean the inside of the door.
